Specification: This module is an auxiliary TLA+ specification intended to be instantiated by another module, as indicated by the comments. It models a trivial one-variable system with state variable x and a constant C, and it defines two helper operators, overloadedName and overloadedConst, to demonstrate name overloading relative to another module. The initial condition uses TLC's Print operator to report the evaluated values of these operators and asserts that overloadedName resolves to the variable x with value "x" and overloadedConst resolves to constant C with value 42; the next-state relation is pure stuttering, and the temporal specification requires Init and then always Next over x.
